text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as Bamboo Memory and I are
getting
ready for the Yasuda Kinen, a
certain piece of
news reaches our ears...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oguri's running in the Yasuda Kinen? For
real?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whooooa! Finally! It took until senior
year, but
I'm finally gonna face off
against Oguri! And in
my best distance
too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm so excited, I can't wait! Come at me,
Oguriiii!
RAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory is practically vibrating
with
uncontrollable excitement. As
usual, she doesn't
appear even vaguely
intimidated by the thought
of racing
against Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But as reassuring as her unshakeable
confidence
is, I am a little worried about
what things will be
like after they
actually face off against each
other.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Trainer! Crank up the
difficulty and
throw whatever you've got
at me! It's time to turn
up the heat so I
can beat Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory, on the other hand, has
nothing
but solid belief in her dream and
continues going
full steam ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I also have to believe in
her
strength and persistence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only a few days remain until the Yasuda
Kinen. I
shake my fear off and renew my
resolve to do
whatever it takes to help
Bamboo Memory win!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(The Yasuda Kinen's almost here. I've
gotta keep
up with my normal training,
but I should probably
ramp up my solo
sessions too...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a quick break, then do one
more lap!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hello, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Working hard, I see.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Yaeno! You here for some
solo
training too?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I also have to prepare for the
Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, I can't wait to run against you and
Oguri for
real!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Just imagining what kind of challenge Oguri's gonna pose has me so excited I can barely breathe!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that she will give us a
spectacular
performance, as she always
does.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're probably right! Gaaaaah!
Why can't
the Yasuda Kinen just come
already?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Your anticipation is palpable. You must
really be
looking forward to competing
against Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am! I mean, she's one of the
ultimate
racers who might be able to
make my dream come
true!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You... do realize she may end up
devouring that
dream of yours, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What do you me—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. Please forget I said
anything.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I... shall take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wait! Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Dang it, I lost her! If I hadn't just finished
running
up and down all those stairs, I
would've been able
to catch her!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You... do realize she may end up
devouring that
dream of yours, right?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. Please forget I said
anything.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I don't get it. What did she mean by
that?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Rgh. I've gotta get even better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When we meet up, Bamboo Memory
opens up to
me about what happened
between her and Yaeno
Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any idea what she meant, so
I was
hoping you might.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What do you think she was getting at
when she
said Oguri might devour my
dream?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah? Yeah?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At her insistence, I begin to explain my

interpretation of what Yaeno Muteki
might have
meant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One of the reasons Oguri Cap is being
hailed as
the star of this generation is
because of the
breadth of her abilities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's excelled in everything from miles
to long
distances. She's demonstrated
incredible
versatility and strength that
was practically
unheard of until now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think Yaeno Muteki was referring to
what may
occur when someone comes
face-to-face with
that kind of
unmatched skill.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suppose there's a racer who has worked
so hard
and gained so much confidence
in her ability to
run miles that she truly
believes she can beat
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And after accomplishing great things
and
convincing the world that she just
might be the
strongest miler out there...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She suddenly finds another racer with
indomitable
strength standing in her
way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What's more, this new contender's
peerless ability
is not limited to just mile
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And just like the sun shines so bright you
can't see
the stars, the miler would fade
from people's
minds in light of the
newcomer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"She's the strongest."
"No one stands a
chance against her."
"She can win any
race there is."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we were to put a name to the racer
everyone
says these things about, it
would be Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki has probably realized this.
And not
just that... she was probably
trying to break it to
Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is a force to be reckoned with
in every
distance—an incandescent flare
that overshadows
every other
Umamusume. And...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: A devourer of dreams, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So, Yaeno was trying to warn me?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But... now that you've said that, I think
you might
be right.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ardan and Chiyono O said something
similar a
while ago as well.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And now even Yaeno thinks so...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right! That settles it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the chat, Trainer! You've
helped me
realize exactly what I have to
do!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If Yaeno feels she has to tell me that, that means I really gotta hit Oguri with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta show Yaeno that I actually can
face
Oguri! If she sees me do that...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
She'll see Oguri isn't someone who
devours
dreams!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ardan once told me there are some
things we can
only convey through
running—not through words!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea how to explain why I
don't think
Oguri is some dream
devourer, but I still wanna
make Yaeno
understand that! That's why I'll just
tell
her through a race!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's the only way I can get my
thoughts through
to her right now!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So, if it's okay with you...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You read my mind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A new light burns in Bamboo Memory's
eyes, and
our excitement for the Yasuda
Kinen roars to a
fever pitch!
